Name: Enchanted Wardrobe - Equipment Forge and Rune System
Author: Natateto
Description:
ENCHANTED WARDROBE
[b]Equipment Rarity • Forge • Runes • Mythic Integration[/b]
Transform ordinary equipment into powerful RPG gear!
Enchanted Wardrobe introduces equipment rarities, randomized attributes, forging, reforging, rune sockets, and equipment progression to Stardew Valley.
Create your own build with attack power, critical hits, movement speed, defense, lifesteal, and more.
[heading]1. Equipment Rarities[/heading]

[b]Luck improves the chances of higher rarities. Legendary rarity can reach up to 2.5%.[/b]
Mythic equipment is registered by compatible external mods. It does not generate new random attributes and features four rune sockets.
[heading]2. Equipment Forge[/heading]
Customize and improve equipment through the Equipment Forge.
[list]
[*][b]Fusion:[/b] Combine three items of the same rarity to create higher-rarity equipment. Legendary cannot be fused into Mythic.[/*]
[*][b]Reforge:[/b] Lock desired attributes and reroll the others using Arcane Fiber.[/*]
[*][b]Dismantle:[/b] Convert unwanted equipment into Arcane Fiber.[/*]
[*][b]Socketing:[/b] Insert and remove runes or Prismatic Shards.[/*]
[*][b]Rune Fusion:[/b] Combine three identical runes of the same tier to create a higher-tier rune.[/*]
[/list][heading]3. Rune System[/heading]

[heading]5. Prismatic Shard Enchantments[/heading]
Insert Prismatic Shards into equipment sockets to obtain one of five vanilla-based enchantments:
[b]Artful, Bug Killer, Crusader, Vampiric, or Haymaker.[/b]
Effects apply while the corresponding equipment is equipped and disappear when it is removed.
Removing a Prismatic Shard from a socket destroys the shard.
[heading]6. Equipment Stats & UI[/heading]
A dedicated interface displays the combined attributes of equipped items.
Additional features include expanded tooltips, scrolling, real-time equipment stat updates, and an optional compact HP/Energy HUD.
Maximum HP bonuses are recalculated when equipment changes, after loading, and after sleeping.
[heading]7. Mythic Integration — API v3[/heading]
Version 1.0.10 introduces improved support for Mythic equipment from external mods.
[list]
[*]Real Mythic rarity and four functional rune sockets.[/*]
[*]Equipment set tooltips displaying equipped parts (1/4–4/4).[/*]
[*]Localized set bonus descriptions.[/*]
[*]Active, inactive, and unimplemented bonus indicators.[/*]
[*]Backward compatibility with API v1/v2.[/*]
[/list][b]Important:[/b] Mythic equipment, its unique abilities, and actual set combat bonuses are implemented by the external mod providing the equipment. Enchanted Wardrobe handles rarity, sockets, and set information displays.
Trial Tower integration is planned. Trial Tower is not required to use Enchanted Wardrobe.
[heading]8. Requirements & Installation[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.14+, SMAPI 4.3.0+, and Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
Extract the
[code]EnchantedWardrobe[/code]folder into your game's
[code]Mods[/code]directory.
Back up your save before updating and avoid duplicate installations.
[b]Languages:[/b] English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese.

[heading]Legacy Save Equipment Recovery — v1.0.19[/heading]
If you're experiencing missing equipment rarities, attributes, or forge compatibility issues on an older save, v1.0.19 introduces optional batch recovery commands.
[b]IMPORTANT: Back up your save before using these commands.[/b]
Move affected equipment into your player inventory before running the commands. Equipped items and items stored in chests are not included.
Option 1 — Recover equipment identity without losing attributes
[code]ew_repair_legacy_batch preview
ew_repair_legacy_batch confirm[/code]First, run
[code]preview[/code]to see eligible items. If the list is correct, run
[code]confirm[/code]within 120 seconds.
This attempts to register eligible equipment with missing internal identities while preserving existing rarity, attributes, sockets, and runes.
Option 2 — Assign new rarity and attributes to completely empty equipment
[code]ew_repair_legacy_batch preview-reset
ew_repair_legacy_batch confirm-reset[/code]Use this option only when the first method cannot help.
This generates new rarity, attributes, and sockets for eligible equipment that has no remaining EW data or previous identity.
[b]This does not restore the item's original attributes. It creates new randomized attributes.[/b]
Safety and Limitations
[list]
[*]Existing valid equipment data is protected.[/*]
[*]Equipment with ambiguous or previously recorded identities is not forcibly reset.[/*]
[*]Mythic equipment provided by other mods is excluded from the reset operation.[/*]
[*]Items that fail safety checks are skipped.[/*]
[*]A result of
[code]candidates=0[/code]means no eligible items were found, not necessarily that your save is fixed.[/*]
[*]These commands do not guarantee recovery of every damaged save.[/*]
[/list]If problems persist, please share your latest SMAPI log and the
[code]EW_BATCH_[/code]messages from the console.
[b]Please keep a backup of your old save instead of deleting it.[/b]
[heading]Feedback[/heading]
Bug reports and suggestions are always welcome. Please include your SMAPI log and steps to reproduce any issues.
[b]Thank you for playing Enchanted Wardrobe![/b]

[heading]기존 세이브 장비 복구 — v1.0.19[/heading]
오래된 세이브에서 장비 등급이나 옵션이 누락되거나 공방에서 장비를 사용할 수 없는 문제가 발생한다면, v1.0.19에서 추가된 일괄 복구 명령어를 사용할 수 있습니다.
[b]중요: 명령어를 사용하기 전에 반드시 세이브를 백업하세요.[/b]
문제가 발생한 장비를 착용 해제하고 플레이어 인벤토리로 옮긴 뒤 명령어를 실행하세요. 착용 중인 장비와 상자에 보관된 장비는 처리 대상에 포함되지 않습니다.
방법 1 — 기존 옵션을 보존하면서 장비 고유 ID 복구
[code]ew_repair_legacy_batch preview
ew_repair_legacy_batch confirm[/code]먼저
[code]preview[/code]를 실행하여 복구 가능한 장비 목록을 확인합니다. 목록이 정확하다면 120초 이내에
[code]confirm[/code]을 실행하세요.
이 기능은 내부 고유 ID가 누락된 적격 장비를 등록하면서 기존 등급·옵션·소켓·룬을 보존합니다.
방법 2 — 데이터가 완전히 비어 있는 장비에 새로운 등급과 옵션 부여
[code]ew_repair_legacy_batch preview-reset
ew_repair_legacy_batch confirm-reset[/code]첫 번째 방법으로 해결할 수 없는 경우에만 사용하세요.
EW 데이터와 이전 식별 정보가 남아 있지 않은 적격 장비에 새로운 등급·옵션·소켓을 부여합니다.
[b]이 기능은 원래 장비의 옵션을 복원하는 것이 아닙니다. 새로운 무작위 옵션을 생성합니다.[/b]
안전장치 및 제한 사항
[list]
[*]정상적인 기존 장비 데이터는 보호됩니다.[/*]
[*]고유 ID가 불분명하거나 과거 식별 기록이 있는 장비는 강제로 초기화하지 않습니다.[/*]
[*]다른 모드에서 제공하는 신화 장비는 초기화 대상에서 제외합니다.[/*]
[*]안전 조건을 충족하지 못하는 장비는 건너뜁니다.[/*]
[*][code]candidates=0[/code]은 복구 대상이 발견되지 않았다는 의미이며, 세이브가 완전히 정상이라는 뜻은 아닙니다.[/*]
[*]이 명령어가 모든 손상된 세이브를 복구한다고 보장하지는 않습니다.[/*]
[/list]문제가 지속된다면 최신 SMAPI 로그와 콘솔에 표시되는
[code]EW_BATCH_[/code]메시지를 공유해 주세요.
[b]기존 세이브를 삭제하지 말고 반드시 백업해서 보관해 주세요.[/b]
[heading]피드백[/heading]
버그 제보와 개선 의견은 언제든 환영합니다. 오류가 발생하면 SMAPI 로그와 재현 방법을 알려 주세요.
[b]Enchanted Wardrobe를 플레이해 주셔서 감사합니다![/b]
